info.title: SocietyTwin research workbench API
info.description: Local development service. Read endpoints work offline from the supplied fixtures and recorded runs. Mutations are accepted from loopback clients only; this is not an authenticated deployment. Synthetic personas and AI-generated responses. Not real people. Not a prediction of real behaviour.

max_attempts.description: 1 = no retry. Retries apply to failed or invalid responses only.

FilterSpec.title: FilterSpec
FilterSpec.description: AND across fields, OR within a field; an omitted field means no restriction.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: stub: offline deterministic placeholder (not a model). matraix: MatrAIx survey agent.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Passed to backends that support a sampling seed.

baseline_fare.title: Baseline Fare

increase_percentage.title: Increase Percentage
increase_percentage.description: Percentage change in tariff (e.g. 20.0 for +20%; negative for a reduction)

policy_summary.title: Policy Summary
policy_summary.description: Summary or rationale of the policy intervention

PopulationFilter.title: PopulationFilter
PopulationFilter.description: AND across fields, OR within a field. ``unavailable`` matches records without a source value.

required_attributes.title: Required Attributes
required_attributes.description: Attributes that must not be null/missing in the synthetic resident record to evaluate eligibility

ask_rationale.title: Ask Rationale

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable text presented to the respondent/agent

QuestionOption.title: QuestionOption
QuestionOption.description: A single allowed option in a survey or choice question.

confirm.title: Confirm

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed narrative of the policy change

ScenarioConfig.title: ScenarioConfig
ScenarioConfig.description: Root configuration model representing a complete policy scenario.

province_code.description: Two-digit TÜİK province code (e.g. '06' for Ankara)

hypothetical.title: Hypothetical
hypothetical.description: Whether the policy intervention is a hypothetical simulation rather than enacted law.

source_note.title: Source Note
source_note.description: Citation or description of empirical baselines, tariffs, or survey instruments used.

ScenarioMetadata.description: Metadata describing authorship, reference periods, and empirical grounding.

save.title: Save

province_codes.title: Province Codes
province_codes.description: Provinces the scenario applies to; None = no restriction.

required_attributes.title: Required Attributes
required_attributes.description: Population attributes required by the scenario; missing or unavailable values block the plan.

unenforced_filters.title: Unenforced Filters
unenforced_filters.description: Scenario filters this runtime cannot enforce; a non-empty list blocks the plan.

ScenarioReference.title: ScenarioReference
ScenarioReference.description:
Provenance and targeting of a definition built from a Scenario Engine config (src/scenarios).

Optional: hand-written definitions omit it. When present, the plan enforces its geographic and age
scope against every sampled persona and blocks execution on any mismatch.
